title: NFL Football
description:
New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills
The Bills (3-0) host the Patriots (1-2) at Highmark Stadium. The Bills beat the Chargers 24-16 behind two Josh Allen rushing TDs, but his status is in question due to a sore knee. New England enters after a 35-6 loss to Jacksonville in Week 3.

title: NFL Football
description:
Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders
The Las Vegas Raiders host the Kansas City Chiefs at Allegiant Stadium in NFL Week 4. Both teams are unbeaten, sitting atop the AFC West. Las Vegas claimed the last meeting, a 14-12 victory in the last game of the regular season on January 4.
